clauses.title: Enterprise Cancellation Fee Waiver
clauses.rule: Waives 100% of standard cancellation fees ($0.00 / ₹0.00) whenever notice is provided >= 2.0 hours prior to scheduled pickup window start.

clauses.title: Carrier-Fault Delay Service Credit
clauses.rule: 100% Service Credit of shipment fee for any carrier-fault delay >= 2.0 hours from scheduled delivery window.

clauses.title: Priority Escalation Tier
clauses.rule: Direct Tier-3 Carrier Liaison dispatch for SLA breaches exceeding 2.0 hours.

clauses.title: Carrier Delay Service Credit
clauses.rule: 50% Service Credit of shipment fee for carrier-fault delays >= 3.0 hours.

clauses.title: Notice Cancellation Schedule
clauses.rule: Standard cancellation fee reduced to $25 (₹2,000) when notice >= 3.0 hours prior to pickup.
